title: Injectivity of the Boolean Word Encoding
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a finite type, let $L\in\mathbb{N}$ be at least the cardinality of $\alpha$, and let $a,b:\alpha\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$. Their length-$L$ encoded Boolean words are equal exactly when $a=b$.
